lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: Contact. Big. Bigger. Captain, it's seven cells. I've never seen seven.

lines.speaker: weave
lines.text: [partial translation] SEVEN. WHOLE. ...SMALL CELLS... COME HOME.

lines.speaker: tern_pilot
lines.text: Comms are jammed! I can't reach Halcyon, I can't reach Sparrow—

lines.speaker: captain
lines.text: Then we fight by line of sight. Everyone stay where I can see you.
